[[Lini Eltring]] is known for having a saying for almost every situation.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lini Eltring}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lini's sayings}} These are often recalled by [[Elayne]] and [[Morgase]], who were nursed by Lini in their childhoods.
